releaseNotes: Updater installation test only: no accounting, project, invoice, contract, or PDF functionality has been changed.
The app version and build identifier are advanced to 225 to test the complete manual update flow from version 224.
Files are downloaded into a separate cache and SHA-256 verified before installation.
Installation starts only after Update Now is pressed; the previous cached build is retained for startup rollback protection.
No accounting records are cleared, migrated, or overwritten by this test build.
